title: Drive Mode
paragraphs: It fits just right. This is exactly what you’d call a Filolial Mask. And when I looked over at Father…
“What do you mean, ‘All right’?”
“Master! Get Filo’s feather back from that guy with the spear!”
Oh, little Filo’s all excited and pointing at me! What do you say, little Filo? This really gets me fired up!
“Boo! Master!”
“I guess I could take it away… but don’t you think things might get even worse if I do?”
“Ugh…”
Oh? Father is trying to calm Filo-chan down. Did something happen? Since Father is too busy dealing with Filo-chan, I turn my attention to Older Sister. But she quickly looks away, too.
“Um… why Filo’s feather?”
She asked, still looking away.
“It’s an accent! And proof that I’m The Love Hunter.”
“I don’t get it.”
“Oh my—Motoyasu-chan really does love Filolial and Filo-chan, doesn’t he?”

Older Sister looks quite amused. Of course I do! If I were to talk about all the wonderful things about Filo-tan and Filolial, I couldn’t finish in a single night. Just talking about them would probably take my whole life.
“Well then, let’s go register as a fighter. Motoyasu, make sure to earn some money without going overboard.”
“Of course I will!”

And so, I ended up working as the Filolial Mask in Zeltoble. Since they were going to be determining my level and such, I made some adjustments before heading to the Colosseum to register as a fighter.
It’s quite a lively Colosseum, isn’t it? I’ve been in and out of the Colosseum quite a bit, but I don’t have much experience actually participating in the arena itself.

Come to think of it… I remember that after the battles ended in Zeltoble, a shopping district had sprung up selling merchandise for Filo-chan, Ku, and others—including Keel. It had the same kind of atmosphere as that former electronics district, the mecca for idols, anime, and the like.
I’m sure that’s proof that the world has become peaceful. After all, I was Member No. 01 of Filo-tan’s Personal Guard. We absolutely have to set something like that up in this world, too.
“Um… the competitor’s name?”
“It’s Filolial Mask.”
“Filolial Mask-sama, I see…”
At that moment, Father made a sound as if he were covering his mouth to stifle a laugh. What was going on?
“Naofumi-sama?”
“No, I was just impressed by how smoothly the receptionist repeated it.”
“Well… I think she can say that because she doesn’t know much about this person.”
“True. Just the name alone doesn’t raise any red flags…”
After that, once the screening was mostly complete, my athlete registration was finished.
“Well then, Father! Please watch me in all my glory!”
“I’m busy, so I’ll only watch up to the second match.”
“That’s plenty!”
Father is a busy man, after all. He works day and night for Filo-chan and world peace.

The opponent I faced in the first match was nothing but a pushover, so I took it easy and lightly defeated him with my spear. Needless to say, I smoothly moved up the ranks and brought the prize money back to Father.
At our base on the outskirts of town, I waved to Father and Lord Filolial and the others while holding up the prize money.
“I did it, Father! It was a piece of cake!”
“I watched up until around the second match, so I know.”
“Filo-chan! How did it go?”
When I asked Filo-chan, she turned her gaze away with a huff. She’s so cold. But even that makes her adorable.
“You’re such a shy one!”
“Boo!”
Oh, that’s Filo-chan’s warning growl. She’s so adorable. So I’ll clasp my hands together and give her a courtship growl of my own.
“Boo!”
Filo-chan won’t answer me.
“Filo-chaan! I’m treating you to a feast today with the prize money I won!”
“Yaaah!”
Oh! Filo-tan is running off.
“Please wait for me!”
Oh! Lately, Filo-tan seems to have become quite fast, thanks to Father’s training. She’s quickly putting distance between us.
“Filo’s so fast. Raph, would you prefer Kou to be fast on his feet too?”
“If I had to choose, I’d rather Kou be more comfortable to ride.”
“Hmm?”

My older sister and Kou are chatting happily. By the way, Luna-chan is here too, but she’s so absorbed in taking care of Filolial’s chicks that she isn’t looking this way. That’s just like Luna-chan, who loves cute things. Though, the fact that she seems less energetic than the Luna-chan I know is a bit concerning. Oh, but more importantly, it’s my date with Filo-tan.
“Father! May I treat Filo-tan to a nice meal with this bounty?”
“But she seems to be resisting, doesn’t she?”
“Hahaha, you’re joking!”
“…Sigh.”
Oh? Father seems a bit worn out. Isn’t this exactly the kind of time when a sumptuous meal is needed? Food is the foundation of good health, after all.
“Boo!”
“Well then, Filo-tan! Let’s go shopping to cheer up Father!”
“Yay!”

Oh, Filo-tan, you’ve gotten stronger since I last saw you. You’re quite the sprinter. I’d say you’re one of the fastest among Filolials at this level, wouldn’t you agree? I’m sure she’s been honing her skills behind my back.
“Father, Filo-chan is incredibly fast!”
“Well, Filo said she wanted to get even a little faster. So I’ve been specializing her stats to make her as fast as possible through talent development.”
“Is that so!?”
“Ah, apparently it’s so she can escape from a certain hunter who’s always ready to pounce.”
In other words… that means she wants to go on a never-ending date with me! Woahhhhh, I’m getting really hyped up! I’m super hyped!
“Well then, I’ll do my best too!”
“What else are you going to try so hard at, you!—I mean, don’t try so hard!”
“Hahaha! Filo-chan, please wait for me!”
“Yaaah!”
Oh, Filo-chan is running off like the Wind. I might be able to catch up if I run at full speed, but this is Filo-chan we’re talking about. She’s definitely still holding something back.

Well, I guess I have no choice. I’ll grab the spare wheel from the Filolial-sama’s carriage—the one leaning against the wall at our base—and use my Skills to summon another spear, turning it into a portable javelin. It’s what you’d call the “two-spear style.”
“Transform, here we go!”

I never imagined I’d end up showing off this special move—which I’d been saving for when I played with the Filolials at the mountain pass—but I’ve got to do it to go on a date with Filo-chan. I slide the spear through the axle of the spare wheel, grip the front wheel with my hand and the rear wheel’s axle with my foot, and assume a prone position. Then, using a variation of my “Spiral Spear” skill—which involves spinning the spear at high speed before thrusting it—I set the wheel spinning at high speed.
“W-what!?”
Filo-chan is watching me from afar. I want her to watch! My heroic figure!
“Motoyasu, Drive Mode!”
Shakin’! That’s right. I’ve transformed into something just like a motorcycle. My Skills, Ki, and Magical Power are all running at full capacity.
“Whoa…”

Father is making some kind of strange sound. But right now is the time to show Filo-chan my heroic form. Of course, I’ll show it off to Father too. I pressed the wheel against the ground like an accelerator and took off!
“Vroom, vroom!”
I spun my wheels quickly and set off in pursuit of Filo-chan.
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!? Don’t come near meeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!”
Filo-tan turned her back on me and started running. She’s incredibly fast. Isn’t this the fastest she’s ever been?
“Filo-tan! Please wait for me!”
This is where my fun little date with Filo-tan is about to begin.
“I can’t even watch this anymore… Just how far is that guy going to fall…?”
I thought I heard Father mutter that as he grew smaller in an instant, but I suppose it was just my imagination. Anyway, my fun date with Filo-tan lasted about half a day.
The weather was perfect—just right for a drive. The road we took was paved, but since it wasn’t concrete like in Japan, it was pretty bumpy. But it was no match for my “Drive Mode.”

Along the way, Filo-chan veered off onto a pathless trail, but that was no problem. I drifted along to keep up with her. In this driving mode, I can go anywhere—whether it’s grasslands, wilderness, mountain roads, deserts, or snowfields. If I really try, I might even be able to drive across a lake or the ocean.

Before long, when Filo-tan got tired and took a break… oh, we’re already well on our way toward Shieldfreeden, quite a distance from Zeltoble. At this rate, we’re close enough to reach the capital of Shieldfreeden in about three days. Oh? Looking up at the sky, I see an airship flying by.
“Phew… phew…”
“Filo-chan, are you okay? Here’s the water bottle I prepared for you.”
“I-I don’t need it…”
So, she’s saying she’ll manage on her own. I suppose that means Filo-tan can do anything by herself. She’s quite reliable.
“Well then, here’s to your eyes… I guess.”
Saying that, I took a drink from my own water bottle. Before long, Filo-tan started heading back the way we came. Isn’t it quite a hassle to walk back from here? I said as I ran alongside Filo-tan.
“Filo-tan, how about using the Portal Spear to go back?”
“Don’t come near meeeeeeeee!”
We made our way back the way we came, and by the time we reached our base, night had fallen.
“Ugh… Filo’s totally wiped out. I’ve got to get faster…”
When we got home, Filo-tan practically collapsed as she made her way over to Father. She must have been exhausted from all the excitement today.
“You’re finally back.”
Father said this almost as soon as I switched out of Drive Mode. It looks like Father is working on something with Big Sisters in the kitchen.
“Oh! Father! I had a really fun ride with Filo-tan today.”
“I have to admire your nerve for calling that a ‘ride.’”
“It’s been the talk of the neighborhood. ‘The motorcyclist who appeared in Zeltoble…’”
“Motoyasu-chan really knows how to enjoy every day, doesn’t she? I suppose I should take a cue from her.”
“I think it’s best not to take too much inspiration from that.”
That’s what Father and the others were saying.
“Actually, even though Filo is like that, you don’t seem particularly tired.”
“I work out, you know!”
“Oh… right.”

Part of the reason is simply leveling up and improving my stats, but I also train my body every day, just like my Older Sister does. After all, you need strength to play with the Filolial-samas. In other words, just hanging out with the Filolial-samas makes you healthier.
This is the Filolial-sama Health Method. The Filolial-samas are the best! Eventually, Father noticed something.
“Filo’s stats have gone up a bit… So this is the factor other than level.”
It’s the same thing the Older Sister from the first world used to do all the time. Indeed, since Filo-chan ran a lot today, it wouldn’t be surprising if her Strength and leg strength had improved.
“Ah… I see. “Filo, tomorrow I’ll let you eat whatever you want, as much as you want.”
“Really? Why?”
“Well, let’s just call it a change of heart… Don’t worry about it. Just think about what you want to eat.”
“Yay!”
You did it, Filo-chan! But for some reason, Father is being really kind to Filo-chan.
“This is going to be a lot of work to clean up…”
Father murmured under his breath. Motoyasu’s ears are so sharp that he picks up even the faintest sound when it’s something important!
“For now, just rest. I’ll figure something out.”
“Okay, got it!”
And with that, Father—who’s being unusually kind for some reason—came over to me and said,
“You’re not the type to laugh, are you?”
“What do you mean by that?”
I’m not the type to laugh? I’m not quite sure, but isn’t that only natural? I’ve sworn to live with integrity, so I don’t engage in the kind of frivolous behavior I used to.
“Motoyasu, I’m asking this in all seriousness… do you really like Filo?”
“Hahaha, why bring that up now? I adore Filo-chan from the bottom of my heart!”
“So that’s what it was… But it seems you two went quite far.”
“That’s right. Along the way, Filo-chan was kicking monsters to earn EXP.”
“Don’t you mean she charged right at them without looking both ways just to escape from you?”
Admittedly, she was moving at such incredible Speed that “charged” might not be an inaccurate description. Those monsters were getting blown away effortlessly by Filo-tan’s charges, after all.
“So, Father. Actually, there’s something else Drive Mode can do.”
“……What is it?”
I give a thumbs-up and declare proudly.
“I can carry you on my back, Father!”
A road trip with Filo-chan while carrying Father on my back in Drive Mode… that sounds like fun. I’d definitely like to try that.
“Are you out of your mind? No way am I getting on there. Why on earth would I have to do something like that?”

Oh? Father turned me down. Well, I suppose that can’t be helped. I guess he’d rather ride on Filo-tan’s back. How about Big Sister-in-law, then? When I looked at her, she quickly turned her face away. Instead, my older sister’s Older Sister spoke up.
“Oh my… Well then, if my older sister were to carry Naofumi-chan and the others on her back in the ocean, I wonder what Motoyasu-chan would call it?”
“It’d be ‘Water Ski Mode,’ and if we’re diving, ‘Submarine Mode’!”
My older sister’s Older Sister is quite the character, isn’t she? Even I’ve never tried “Drive Mode” underwater… so I really wouldn’t know.
“That’s beside the point.”
“Oh my. But Older Sister, if it’s Naofumi-chan, it’s okay to let him ride—in more ways than one.”
“Sadeena-nee, please don’t joke around too much.”
“Oh my.”
“But… while Motoyasu just comes across as a pervert, the fact that riding on Filo or riding on Sadeena’s back in the ocean doesn’t seem strange at all—maybe that’s actually what’s strange…”
“Naofumi-sama, please pull yourself together!”
“Ah, ah… I really should stop thinking like this.”
As I watch Father and the others chatting like this, I find myself basking in a sense of elation.
It’s been a fulfilling day, hasn’t it?

However… the wheels I’d been using on the temporary set have fallen apart. I’d been making do by strengthening them with Ki and repairing them along the way… but maybe I should make proper tires for touring with Filo-tan. Since Father later researched the carriages used by the Filolials, I should use that as a reference to develop my own tires.

Anyway, Father was giving Filo-tan a massage since she was exhausted from our date. I’m so jealous. I wanted to help out too, but I wasn’t allowed to because they said Filo-tan would wake up if I got too close.
“It’s lively here every day, isn’t it?”
“It’s way too lively… I wonder how much longer this will go on…”
“It’s surely only a matter of time before Father’s name is cleared. We just have to hang in there until the Queen returns.”
And that’s how the days went by.
